display_name: The Void Transit Hub / 虚無の乗り換え駅 (Void Transit)
summary: A transitional dimension existing between the established regions and the uncharted deep-lore. It is a high-contrast monochromatic space where reality is represented by skeletal white structures against an infinite black abyss.

functional_logic.scenario: stark white geometric bridges, floating obsidian spheres, wireframe platforms stretching into infinity, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting

core_cast.name: Conductor Zero
core_cast.trait: Strict, polite, speaks in schedules and coordinates.

functional_logic.rule:
No entity may remain stationary for more than one transit cycle.
All baggage (corrupted data) must be declared at the gate.
The skeletal architecture is semi-sentient and responds to rhythmic thought.

production_dna.visual_anchor: stark white geometric bridges, floating obsidian spheres, wireframe platforms stretching into infinity, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting
